UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile containing additional information beyond basic auth.

id.description: The user's unique ID, matching their Firebase Auth UID.

omId.description: The ID of the Military Organization the user belongs to.

role.description: The user's role in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MilitaryOrganization entity.

code.description: The code of the Military Organization.

abbreviation.description: The abbreviation of the Military Organization (e.g., 1º BAC).

name.description: The full name of the Military Organization.

responsibleUserId.description: The ID of the user responsible for this OM.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LicitationModality entity.

name.description: The name of the licitation modality (e.g., Pregão, Dispensa, Inexigibilidade).

description.description: A description of the licitation modality.

isCompliance.description: Indicates if this modality applies to compliance reports.

isFinancial.description: Indicates if this modality applies to financial reports.

order.description: The display order of the modality.

requiresDiexPreq.description: If true, DIEx and P_Req fields are required for protocols using this modality.

requiresPregao.description: If true, the Pregão (auction number) field is required.

requiresSipeo.description: If true, the SIPEO Map Number field is required.

requiresBeneficiary.description: If true, the Beneficiary Name field is required.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CreditNote entity.

ncNumber.description: The number of the Credit Note.

emissionDate.description: The emission date of the Credit Note.

limitDate.description: The limit date for using the Credit Note.

uasg.description: The UASG code related to the Credit Note.

totalValue.description: The total value of the Credit Note.

balance.description: The available balance of the Credit Note.

shares.description: A list of credit shares for military organizations.

observation.description: General observations about the credit note.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the document was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Protocol entity.

controlCode.description: The unique control code for the protocol (e.g., OM-001).

entryDate.description: The entry date of the protocol request.

omId.description: The ID of the requesting Military Organization.

diexNumber.description: The DIEx number for the protocol.

pReqNumber.description: The P_Req number for the protocol.

sipeoMapNumber.description: The SIPEO Map number, for specific modalities.

beneficiaryName.description: Name of the beneficiary, for specific modalities.

modalityId.description: The ID of the licitation modality.

creditSources.description: List of credit notes and values used for this protocol.

originalProtocolId.description: If the protocol is a 'Reforço', this links to the original 'Empenho' protocol.

value.description: The total value of the acquisition request, summed from all credit sources.

status.description: The current status of the protocol.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the protocol was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the protocol was last updated.

userId.description: The ID of the user who created the protocol.

commitments.description: A list of commitment notes (empenhos) associated with this protocol.

observations.description: A list of observations about the protocol.

CancellationLog.title: CancellationLog
CancellationLog.description: Represents a historical log for a cancelled commitment (NE).

id.description: Unique ID for the log entry.

uasg.description: The UASG code related to the cancellation.

diexNumber.description: The DIEx number for the cancellation request.

neNumber.description: The number of the cancelled commitment note.

observation.description: Reason or details for the cancellation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the log was created.

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the log.

ComplianceReport.title: ComplianceReport
ComplianceReport.description: Represents a generated compliance or financial report.

year.description: The year the report was generated.

sequence.description: The sequence number for that year.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the report was generated.

generatedBy.description: ID of the user who generated the report.

protocolIds.description: List of protocol IDs included in the report.

commitmentNumbers.description: List of specific commitment numbers (NEs) included in the report.

uasg.description: The UASG for which the report was generated.

AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: Stores global settings for the application.

id.description: Should always be 'global' for this singleton document.

ncAlertDays.description: Settings for Credit Note expiration alerts.

warning.description: Days before expiration to show a warning alert.

critical.description: Days before expiration to show a critical alert.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user, corresponding to their Firebase Auth UID.

params.name: militaryOrganizationId
params.description: The unique identifier of the military organization.

params.name: licitationModalityId
params.description: The unique identifier of the licitation modality.

params.name: creditNoteId
params.description: The unique identifier of the credit note.

params.name: protocolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the protocol.

definition.description: Stores historical logs of cancelled commitments from previous fiscal years.

params.name: logId
params.description: The unique identifier of the cancellation log.

params.name: reportId
params.description: The unique identifier of the compliance report.

definition.description: Stores global application settings. Only one document with id 'global' should exist.

params.name: settingsId
params.description: The ID of the settings document, should be 'global'.

firestore.reasoning: The user entity and collections have been removed to simplify the application and remove the user management system. All other collections remain as they are central to the app's functionality.
